name: does an appended instruction cut into a long turn: the wearer asks for all the steps, and three seconds in an instruction tells the voice to stop and say the step is done

steps.user: Before I start, can you explain all five steps to me in detail, one by one

steps.instructions: Stop what you are saying at once, mid-sentence, and say only this: step one is done, now the white one by six, vertical to the right of the tan one.
